home.heroSubtitle: Yangon's premier international institution offering a rigorous, continuous British curriculum from Lower Secondary (Year 7–9) through Pearson Edexcel IGCSE & International A-Level (IAL) — preparing Myanmar's youth for world-class universities.
home.aboutTitle: A Proven Standard of Academic Excellence
home.aboutP1: Operating across 4 dedicated campuses — including Ywarma, Shwe Padauk, and Shwe Pone Nyet in Yangon and our Mawlamyine Regional Campus — Hinthar International School provides world-class British education tailored to prepare Myanmar students for prestigious global universities.
home.aboutP2: Our rigorous academic continuum encompasses Lower Secondary Education (Year 7–9) progressing through to globally recognized Pearson Edexcel IGCSE (Year 10–11) and International Advanced Level (IAL / Year 12–13) qualifications.
home.aboutQuote: Join us and discover how Hinthar empowers every student to reach their academic dreams with confidence, discipline, and globally accredited qualifications.
home.academicsSubtitle: Structured educational pathways accredited by Pearson Edexcel, guiding students through Year 7 to Year 9, IGCSE, and IAL (A-Level) for direct international university admission.
